verdict.rationale: Gusto ships an official public CLI in the Gusto GitHub org, installable from its own cli.gusto.com domain, with versioned releases. It is built for agents: an --agent/--json envelope, documented exit codes, --dry-run, a --confirm write gate, a first-party AGENTS.md, bundled agent skills, and headless token auth. missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration beyond repo and probe records, plus a captured first-party product page (it returned 403); the CLI is also pre-1.0 (v0.3.0) and only drafts payroll, with no run/submit command.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Agent-friendly developer interface for Gusto payroll. From curl | sh to running per-cycle payroll prep in a single chat session with an agent.
# Working with the gusto CLI (for agents)
installs to ~/.gusto/bin/gusto with no sudo, and updates PATH
